unused_id_reasons.IDEA-20260902-be04b4: The object enumeration below honestly yielded two records that pass the lossy-projection test with a concrete, falsifiable one-step measurement and are not a re-parameterisation of an off-limits family. laneA.retrieval_outage_disclosure: The crypto-kb MCP index is empty in this container (CRYPTO_KB_QDRANT_URL is ':memory:'). search_knowledge, get_context, get_source and find_related were NOT called. Screening was by direct Read and Grep over ledger/, knowledge/, analysis/ and ideas/ plus three WebSearch calls and two WebFetch attempts. Every 'no hit' below is a floor, never evidence of absence. Two broad corpus-wide greps timed out and were re-run on narrower paths; a 250-file saturated hit list for 'primitiv|affine group|GL_m' was narrowed to 'Borel|2-transitiv|AGL|GL_2(...)' before use.

scientific_boundary: This snapshot archives the filed IDEA records and the ideation handoff byte-for-byte as PROPOSALS only. No hypothesis, experiment, evidence, or decision record is created and no status changes; approval is /design-experiment under Coordinator authority. No record claims an attack, speedup, closure, or novelty above unverified; every sota_delta is stated quantitatively by its own record and adopted by nobody. Generator-enumerated closures are the generators' claims, reviewed by nobody, and are not adopted by this archive.
self_neutrality: The receipt cannot embed its own final hash, size, commit SHA, or parent SHA. Those remain null; every other declared path is hashed from its final pre-commit bytes under content_first.
